summary: Converts 8-bit grayscale texture data to 32-bit float RGBA. Computes the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050). Loops over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels, consuming one byte per pixel, writes the byte scaled by 0.0039215689 (the 1/255 float folded from flt_59E460) to all three RGB channels, and sets the alpha channel to 1.0 for each pixel, writing four floats per pixel. If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, calls ContactManifoldCleanup on the decoded float RGBA buffer.

operations.description: Compute the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050).
Iterate over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels, consuming one byte per pixel (end pointer is src + this[1046]) and writing four floats per pixel.
Decode the grayscale value as the byte scaled by 0.0039215689 and write it to all three RGB channels of the output pixel.
Set the alpha channel of the output pixel to 1.0.
Advance the input pointer by one byte and the output pointer by four floats each iteration.
If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, run the post-processing cleanup on the decoded buffer.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup(this, output_base) where output_base is computed as the base of the decoded float RGBA buffer (a4 - 4 * this[1046]).
